title: Get Ricked
description: A fabric mod that adds an enchantment that spawns helper zombies, called "ricks", that help you defeat the enemy
body:
# About
**Get Ricked** is a fabric mod that I made to learn the basics of fabric modding. It adds a helper mob, named **Rick**, that helps players defeat other enemies. It is spawned when a player hits an entity with a weapon enchanted with **Ricking**.

# Features
- Naturally generating Rickstone Ore that drops 1 Rickstone Powder and is immune to Silk Touch and Fortune.
- Crafting recipe requiring 9 Rickstone Powder for 1 Rickstone.
- Crafting recipe requiring 1 Book and 4 Rickstone for one Enchanted Book with Ricking 1. Higher levels are obtained at the anvil or at the enchanting table.
- When a player hits another entity with a weapon enchanted with Ricking, a number of Ricks are spawned, depending on the level of the enchantment. The Ricks will only attack that entity, unless attacked themselves.
